description: Eight step sequencer giving a control voltage, a trigger and a gate per step, with voltage control over the sequence length and the play direction

params.text: Sets the voltage carried by OUT while that step is active, 0V to 8V before the SCALE switch is applied
Sets how many of the eight steps play, from 1 to 8. The small green lights mark the steps that fall within that length
Sets the range of the CV outputs to 2V, 4V or 8V, a step knob at its maximum giving that voltage
Picks forward, where the sequence runs left to right and starts over on the left; pendulum, where it runs out and back; or reverse, where it runs right to left
Turns the trigger on or off for that step; TRIG then goes high for as long as the clock pulse is high
Turns the gate on or off for that step; GATE then stays high for the whole step, and two neighbouring steps turned on give one gate across both

inputs.text: A high gate runs the sequencer and a low gate pauses it, picking up again at the next clock; with nothing patched the sequencer runs. 2V starts it, 0.1V stops it
A rising edge moves the sequencer on one step, and the time the clock spends high sets how long TRIG stays high. The threshold is 2V for high, 0.1V for low
A rising edge restarts the sequence at step one on the next clock; when reset and clock arrive within 100 microseconds of each other it moves to step one at once
Sets the sequence length from the applied voltage and takes the LENGTH switch out of circuit while a cable is patched; 10V gives all eight steps
Sets the play direction from the applied voltage and takes the DIRECTION switch out of circuit: under 2V forward, 2V to 4V pendulum, over 4V reverse

outputs.text: Goes to 10V on any step whose trigger is turned on, for as long as the clock pulse is high
Goes to 10V for the whole of any step whose gate is turned on; two neighbouring steps turned on give a single gate lasting across both
The current step's knob voltage, scaled by the SCALE switch. It changes on every step whether or not that step has a trigger or a gate turned on
The current step's knob voltage scaled by the SCALE switch and then negated, so a knob turned up gives a negative voltage

notes: SX-CV8, SX-OUT8 and SX-TRIG8 add further channels of output when placed immediately to the right, and the context menu will add a compatible expander for you
with the mouse pointer over the module, Shift+Ctrl+C randomizes the step knobs, Shift+Ctrl+G the gates, Shift+Ctrl+T the triggers and Shift+Ctrl+R all three
menu: Initialize — puts step settings back to their defaults, with a choice of CV only, Gates only, Triggers only or CV/Gates/Triggers only
Randomize — sets step settings at random, with a choice of CV only, Gates only, Triggers only or CV/Gates/Triggers only
Add CV expander — places a Sequencer CV Expander to the right of this module
Add output expander — places a Sequencer Output Expander to the right of this module
Add trigger expander — places a Sequencer Trigger Expander to the right of this module
Add random melody expander — places a Gated Comparator Random Melody expander to the right of this module
Add logic expander — places a Gated Comparator Gate Logic expander to the right of this module

inputs.0: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
